clue.text: A man of means-and to top it a heel!

parts.note: to cap something is to top it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Describing a wealthy man and adding, as a final insult, that he is a cad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heel' reads as a cad but is the nautical verb: a heeling ship lists.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who owns and invests wealth is a person of means in a market economy.

clue.text: A hold-up caused by the number-one man

the letters escape out of the words around them

clue.text: Skilled worker giving unusual names to his offspring

clue.text: Singer made to give up

clue.text: C division of the county

explanation.definitionFit: C is the Roman numeral for the number, and old English shires were split into administrative districts by that name.

clue.text: Constituents of the Tory now, and that's significant

explanation.surface: Today's Conservative party members are important.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constituents of' signals an anagram of THE TORY NOW.
explanation.definitionFit: Something worth noting is significant, remarkable.

explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' means the word for very old is read backwards.

clue.text: Act through a group of scholars

clue.text: A certain weight of coin

definitions.meaning: a unit of weight of sixteen ounces
the British unit of currency, a coin

clue.text: A theatricalsetting

parts.note: the scenery and furnishings of a stage production

clue.text: To do with imbibing at speed

parts.note: re means concerning, to do with
taken as written

clue.text: The French like areas of grassland

parts.note: le is the French masculine word for the
as means like

explanation.surface: French people fond of open meadows.
explanation.definitionFit: A lea is a poetic word for a meadow or pasture.

clue.text: Refreshment for the guy on the beat

definitions.text: Refreshment for the guy on the beat

parts.words: Refreshment for the guy on the beat
parts.note: reads as a snack for a patrolling policeman, but means a reviving steam bath where bathers are beaten with birch twigs

explanation.definitionFit: In a Finnish steam bath bathers traditionally beat themselves with birch twigs, so it refreshes someone being thrashed.

clue.text: Make a song about a hole being offensive

parts.note: to sing is to make a song
a pit is a hole

clue.text: Dicky, a driver, achieved sue cess

clue.text: Worn and dilapidated, but used

clue.text: Turn pale when cut by it

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: To whiten is to blanch or go white.

clue.text: The economy, calls for some growth

explanation.surface: Calls in the economy for growth.

clue.text: Taking over the church at one time

parts.note: on can mean upon or over

explanation.surface: Seizing control of the church in former days.

clue.text: Suffices for some animals
